sv.title: Yasin Ayari om succén och målet mot Man City: ”Lite revansch”
sv.summary: Yasin Ayari har ett starkt år bakom sig. Nyligen slog han dessutom till mot Manchester City. – Det var lite som en revansch, säger Brighton-stjärnan.

en.title: Yasin Ayari on success and the goal against Man City: "A bit of revenge"
en.summary: Yasin Ayari has had a strong year. Recently he also struck against Manchester City. "It was a bit like revenge," says the Brighton star.
